metadata.title: feat(teams): comprehensive team management — role hierarchy, OIDC sync, admin UI team scoping
metadata.author: ecthelion77

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue

Supersedes #3999 (which only covered SSO_ENTRA_TEAM_MAPPING).

This PR delivers the complete team management feature set: role hierarchy, OIDC group synchronization, team-scoped entity management in the admin UI, and proper team ownership isolation.

---

## 🔗 Epic / Issue

Closes #3997

## 🚀 Summary

This PR adds comprehensive multi-team management capabilities to MCP Context Forge, enabling enterprise deployments where multiple teams share a single gateway instance with proper isolation and role-based access control.

### Key features:

#### 1. Role hierarchy (`platform_user`, `developer`, `viewer`)
- **`platform_user`**: Existing admin role renamed for clarity — full CRUD on all entities
- **`developer`**: Can create and manage servers, tools, prompts, resources within their team
- **`viewer`** (formerly `member`): Read-only access to team resources
- Global role dropdown replaces the simple Admin checkbox on user edit forms

#### 2. OIDC group synchronization
- New `oidc_sync_enabled`, `oidc_group_claim`, and `oidc_group_value` fields on the Team model
- When enabled, users are automatically assigned to teams based on OIDC token claims during SSO login
- Alembic migration adds the new columns to the existing teams table

#### 3. SSO Entra team mapping (`SSO_ENTRA_TEAM_MAPPING`)
- Declarative environment variable mapping Entra ID groups to gateway teams
- Processed during SSO bootstrap to auto-create teams and assign users

#### 4. Admin UI team-scoped entity management
- Team dropdown added to all create and edit forms (servers, gateways, tools, prompts, resources, A2A agents)
- Team selection is preserved during entity edits (no longer reset to None)
- JavaScript refactored into modular `admin_ui/*.js` files with shared `populateTeamSelect()` utility
- Team selects are populated dynamically via `/api/teams` API

#### 5. Team ownership isolation
- `verify_team_for_user()` raises `PermissionError` instead of silently allowing cross-team access
- Edit endpoints preserve the original `team_id` — entity ownership cannot be changed after creation
- Proper team validation on all CRUD operations

### Files changed (23 files, +548/-250):

| Area | Files |
|------|-------|
| Backend | `admin.py`, `schemas.py`, `config.py`, `db.py`, `bootstrap_db.py` |
| Services | `team_management_service.py`, `sso_service.py`, `prompt_service.py`, `resource_service.py`, `tool_service.py` |
| Admin UI JS | `utils.js` (new), `servers.js`, `gateways.js`, `tools.js`, `prompts.js`, `resources.js`, `a2aAgents.js`, `initialization.js`, `formSubmitHandlers.js` |
| Templates | `admin.html`, `team_users_selector.html` |
| SSO | `sso_bootstrap.py` |
| Migration | `f7a2b1c3d4e5_add_oidc_sync_to_teams.py` |

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes
- [x] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing)

---

## 📓 Notes

### Relationship to PR #3999

PR #3999 (`feat/sso-entra-team-mapping-upstream`) only covers the `SSO_ENTRA_TEAM_MAPPING` environment variable (1 commit). This PR is the comprehensive implementation that includes SSO team mapping plus all the other team management capabilities. PR #3999 can be closed in favor of this one.

### Migration

The Alembic migration `f7a2b1c3d4e5_add_oidc_sync_to_teams.py` adds three nullable columns to the `teams` table. It is safe to apply on existing databases — no data migration needed.

### Admin UI architecture

The JavaScript has been refactored from inline scripts in `admin.html` into modular files under `admin_ui/`:
- `utils.js`: Shared utilities including `populateTeamSelect()`
- Each entity type has its own JS module
- `initialization.js`: DOMContentLoaded setup

commits.message:
feat(teams): SSO team mapping, OIDC sync, developer role, team RBAC

- Add SSO-based team auto-assignment via OIDC group claims
- Support multiple OIDC group IDs per team (JSON column)
- OIDC groups UI: table with Display Name + Group ID columns
- Add developer role between member and owner
- Team-scoped RBAC for servers, tools, prompts, resources
- Bootstrap default teams from OIDC_TEAM_MAPPING env var
- Admin UI: create/edit team modals with OIDC sync settings
